_help: Owner-only settings for ox in this project. Agents can't change this file during unattended runs, and subagents never can. Change the mode with /ox:mode. Explained in the ox:playbook skill.
_specNote: specApproved is false while an idea-first project waits for the owner to approve the spec and plan; a hook blocks building until it is true. Only an attended session can change it.
_burstNote: Burst days are the two days before your weekly limit resets, so leftover credits get used. Set them with: node <kit>/scripts/install-project-files.mjs --project . --reset-day Tue (or ask Claude: /ox:doctor fix). maxRunsInARow is a hard stop so back-to-back runs can't go on forever.

gates._help: What must pass before work moves on. item: once per item, fast. batch: the full regression, run when due; a pass moves the base branch. phase: slow end-to-end checks, at a check-in. Empty lists fall back to tests.command. See the gates page of the ox:playbook skill.

_why.lint: undefined names, bad imports, unused code
_why.typecheck: a change that breaks a shared type or an adapter contract somewhere else
_why.test:unit: the changed logic is wrong; an AC id with no test
one merged item broke the logic of another
_why.test:functions: backend and AI-gateway contract regressions, on recorded fixtures (no paid calls)
_why.test:rules: a family seeing or editing a kitchen that is not theirs; allowance counters writable from the app
_why.build: the production bundle no longer builds

_why.e2e: a key journey no longer works end to end at phone sizes, against the emulators
_why.build:android:debug: native config or a plugin broke the installable build (needs the Android SDK: the owner's computer or CI, not a cloud session)

gates._status: Designed at /ox:init. None of these scripts exist yet: PLAN item W-001 (test harness) creates them, and each is run and timed before the gates count as live.

blockedCommands.why: submitting for store review is the owner's check-in.
uploads go to the internal testing track only; promoting builds is the owner's call.
deploys go only to the dev project named in .ox/PROJECT.md (pass --project <dev id>). Production deploys are the owner's check-in.
the shared AI-gateway package is installed from git, never published to a public registry.
the bake-off calls paid AI and receipt services. Only the owner starts it (npm run evals:dry is free and allowed).
